source_text: Consequens nunc videtur... pauca de ipso mundo repetere, id est de initio eius ac fine...
pass_a_gloss: It now seems fitting to repeat a few things about the world itself — its beginning and end.
pass_b_english: Book II takes up the world properly: its beginning, end, and what providence dispenses between. Bodily nature’s persistence is discussed without making matter a second unbegotten principle. The world’s start and causes are read under one Creator.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
